**The Rose Room** is a location in the Savage Divide region of Appalachia.

The Rose Room appears in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Atlantic City America's Playground* update.

Senior Quest Designer Ellys Tan stated that the location was re-worked into a nightclub, as the mansion came closest to the high life that the Russo family used to have in Atlantic City. [Dev 1]
